# ESPN Lacrosse Fixtures

Captured 2026-11-25 for the offline `espn_lacrosse_*` parser tests. One subdirectory per ESPN
league slug, one file per endpoint.

| File | URL |
|---|---|
| `pll/site-v2/scoreboard.json` | `https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/lacrosse/pll/scoreboard?dates=20260801` |
| `pll/site-v2/teams.json` | `https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/lacrosse/pll/teams` |
| `pll/site-v2/standings.json` | `https://site.api.espn.com/apis/v2/sports/lacrosse/pll/standings` |
| `mens-college-lacrosse/site-v2/scoreboard.json` | `https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/lacrosse/mens-college-lacrosse/scoreboard` (served the 2026-05-25 final) |
| `womens-college-lacrosse/site-v2/scoreboard.json` | `https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/lacrosse/womens-college-lacrosse/scoreboard` (served the 2026-05-24 final) |
